name: lingmind
description: Use project-scoped LingMind business queries, writes, jobs, missions, waylines, media, devices, and daily reports through Phoenix MCP.

interface.longDescription: Use one LingMind business environment through Phoenix's explicit CapabilityRegistry. Resolve project context; query and change business records; operate jobs, missions, waylines, media, streams, UAV, NVR, robots, and devices; generate daily business reports; and use plan/confirm/execute for destructive or physical actions.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the active incidents in my LingMind project
Generate a wayline and prepare a mission action plan
Generate a UAV or camera daily report from authorized business facts
